title: requirements.functional-only.json
description: Optional companion schema for the requirements artifact when the pipeline enforces a functional-only spec (Axe 5). Pure-shape validation; the technology-keyword check lives in the `requirements-functional-only` kind of aidp-validate-artifact and emits a warning rather than a hard fail.

ticket.description: Jira ticket key when the requirements come from a Jira ticket. Null for greenfield runs that produce a fresh spec.

user_story.description: Optional 'As a <user>, I want <action>, so that <value>' line.

acceptance_criteria.description: List of acceptance criteria. Each item should be a single, testable statement.

statement.description: Single, testable assertion. No tech keywords (Lambda, DynamoDB, ...). Those belong to the architectural_brief.

out_of_scope.description: Explicitly listed non-goals. Useful to prevent scope creep upstream of the architectural brief.

open_questions.description: Questions the agent could not resolve from the ticket alone. The orchestrator may surface them via blocking_questions.json.
